name: dsh-ide-vscode
description: DSH 右侧栏内置 IDE：跟随会话工作区的文件树 + 编辑区（行号、语法高亮、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制行），Windows 系统原生文件图标，图片与音视频预览，压缩包列成员 / 解压 / 打包走系统 tar，按名搜索或粘路径跳转。 Built-in IDE panel for DeepSeek Harness: a workspace tree that follows the session plus an editor with line numbers, syntax highlighting, Ctrl+S save and Ctrl+D line duplicate, native file-type icons on Windows, image and audio/video preview, archive listing / unpack / zip packing through the system tar, and search by name or jump by pasted path.

scripts.test: node test/host-smoke.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs && node test/dom-e2e.mjs
